Maya: Heads-up — BrightBridge token usage dropped ~73% in the last 30d. Procurement pinged us yesterday asking for pricing comps; they're running a side-by-side with two vendors. Renewal ~6w. Need triage.
Ravi: Ack. Any stakeholder changes? Is this a champion loss?
Maya: Yes — Tom (champion) moved to a different team 4w ago. New Head of Data Elena is the decision lead, started 3w ago. Procurement's focused on latency + cost.
Jules: Do we have telemetry showing errors or slower embeddings? Could be config/quant issue.
Maya: Quick snapshot: last30d tokens: 18k (prior 68k). Embeddings error rate up 5% -> 12%. Avg gen latency +40ms. Link to dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/brightbridge/usage
Ravi: Proposed immediate plan: 1) Technical deep-dive with Elena + SE to reduce embeddings errors (Jules). 2) Commercial: short-term capacity/discount to stop churn while we fix root cause (CS + AE).
Maya: I'll own customer outreach and set up the technical sync. @Jules can you take SE lead?
Jules: Yup. Need sample failing request + model config + quantization used. Also need KV cache stats if they're using long context.
Maya: Pasting sample log snippet from the customer's last failing call:
```
HTTP 400 - invalid vector size
payload: {"model":"open-embedding-050", "dim":768, "vectors":[...]}
request_id: br-req-20240312-9a1b
```
Maya: They also mentioned switching to a competing vendor's hosted embeddings trial last week — procurement asked for transcribed performance numbers.
Ravi: I'll draft commercial options: (A) 3mo trial on Dedicated w/ 20% discount, (B) 6mo price protection if errors <2% after fixes. Legal may need to review.
Maya: Opsbot — create a tracker ticket and add the QBR template for BrightBridge.
opsbot: Created CS-4521 "BrightBridge embeddings perf investigation" assigned to Jules; also created CS-4522 QBR prep doc.
Jules: I'll start triage now. Maya — please DM me the sample logs and access to their config. I may need an eng-runtime oncall peek if it's infra.
Maya: Done — shared logs + a read-only dashboard link. Scheduling technical sync for tomorrow 10:00 PT with Elena. QBR tentatively next Tuesday.
Ravi: I'll prepare commercial options & pre-read. Plan: technical sync tomorrow, QBR next week, commercial proposal within 48h post-sync. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — will update this thread after the sync.
